title: Let's migrate away from writing out a complete /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg in ubuntu-server livecd and instead inject individual config parts so the whole of /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg doesn't get outdated.
description:
Let's migrate away from writing out a complete /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg in ubuntu-server livecd and instead inject individual config parts so the whole of /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg doesn't get outdated.

I have separated the commits here to help in review. If we plan on squash merging, i can write up a single commit message that describes the overall intent.

All original config behavior in liveCD is retained, but as separate config parts files to aid in
discoverability, and avoid overwriting the default /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg delivered by upstream cloud-init.

In this PR I've migrated parts of the whole cloud.cfg content into separate files to aid visibility to what the live installer actually overrides.

Special care should be used in reviewing the last commit which creates

live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-limit-config-modules.cfg

We need to understand the motivation for live installer environments limiting
the modules being run in ephemeral timeframe because this significantly blocks use-cases
where cloud-init userdata may want to specialize the ephemeral installer by adding packages
or apt repos, set locale early in boot write-files to the ephemeral environment etc.

         mkdir -p chroot/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d
-        cat <<EOF > chroot/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg
+        cat <<EOF > chroot/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg
 # Let NetworkManager manage all devices on this system
 system_info:
   network:
@@ -1021,12 +1021,12 @@ EOF
         mkdir -p chroot/etc/cloud/clean.d
         cat <<EOF > chroot/etc/cloud/clean.d/99-installer-use-networkmanager
 # Inform clone image creators about strict network-manager cfg for cloud-init
-if [ -f /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg ]; then
+if [ -f /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg ]; then
   echo "WARNING: cloud-init network config is limited to using network-manager."
-  echo "If this is undesirable: rm /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg"
+  echo "If this is undesirable: rm /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-use-networkmanager.cfg"
 fi
 EOF
-        chmod +x chroot/etc/cloud/clean.d/99-installer-use-networkmanager
+        chmod +x chroot/etc/cloud/clean.d/80-installer-use-networkmanager
     else
         echo "==== NetworkManager not installed ===="
     fi

+# Allow the ability to ssh login during the installer ephemeral boot on
+# headless nodes to drive installer TUI while remotely attached over ssh.
+ssh_pwauth: yes
+chpasswd:
+    expire: false
+
+system_info:

+      name: installer
+      lock_passwd: false

diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-limit-config-modules.cfg b/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-limit-config-modules.cfg

index 0000000..5abd7a0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-limit-config-modules.cfg
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+# Limit cloud-config modules run within the server live installer
+# REVIEW: xnox, mwhudson, dbungert do we actually want this limited
+# set of cloud-config modules for a specific reason?
+
+
+# As cloud-init grows support for more modules, do we specifically
+# want to avoid running some of this in installer ephemeral stage?
+
+
+# I've cut-n-pasted the existing subset of modules from the former
+# livecd-rootfs drop-in /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg file
+# for thorough review/comment. I'd suggest we don't include this file unless
+# there is a reason we intend to omit certain modules, otherwise it will
+# get out of date (as it already has) vs upstream cloud-init modules added.
+
+# The modules that run in the 'init' stage
+cloud_init_modules:
+ - bootcmd
+ - write-files
+ - ca-certs
+ - rsyslog
+ - users-groups
+ - ssh
+
+# The modules that run in the 'config' stage
+cloud_config_modules:
+# Emit the cloud config ready event
+# this can be used by upstart jobs for 'start on cloud-config'.
+ - ssh-import-id
+ - set-passwords
+ - timezone
+ - disable-ec2-metadata
+ - runcmd
+
+# The modules that run in the 'final' stage
+cloud_final_modules:
+ - scripts-per-once
+ - scripts-user
+ - ssh-authkey-fingerprints
+ - keys-to-console
+ - phone-home
+ - final-message
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-network.cfg b/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-network.cfg
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b6b919
--- /dev/null
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-server/includes.chroot.ubuntu-server-minimal.ubuntu-server.installer/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/80-installer-network.cfg
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# This is the initial network config to ensure ephemeral installer sets
+# up networking on any interface presented to the system
+# It can be overwritten by cloud-init /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/ or subiquity.
+network:
+    version: 2
+    ethernets:
+        zz-all-en:
+            match:
+                name: "en*"
+            dhcp4: true
+        zz-all-eth:
+            match:
+                name: "eth*"
+            dhcp4: true
